verdict.rationale: Unleash documents API keys for SDKs, Edge, and other tools and automation (docs-23), and backend tokens can be scoped to specific projects and a single environment (docs-15, docs-34). RBAC also supports custom root and project roles (docs-12, docs-32), and an MCP server lets coding assistants create and manage flags (docs-7). However, the evidence never shows how the admin-level credentials an agent needs to manage flags through the Admin API or MCP server are scoped to least privilege. Missing for 10: documented scoping of admin/automation tokens or service accounts for agents, guidance on least-privilege credentials for the MCP server, and independent corroboration.
